rounds.text: The business demonstrates a powerful acceleration in profitability, featuring a net profit surge of 567% year-over-year [E39] alongside a trailing twelve-month compounded profit growth of 97% [E16]. This bottom-line explosion is supported by robust top-line momentum, evidenced by a 10-year compounded sales growth of 102% [E13] and a trailing twelve-month sales growth of 21% [E14] that outpaces the sector median of 16.6% [E48]. Crucially, the company is almost debt-free [E31], providing a clean balance sheet to support ongoing earnings expansion and improving operational metrics. Results are actively improving with an impressive results score of 81 out of 100 [E45], signaling a potential fundamental turnaround that outpaces stale market sentiment [E45]. Conceded: [E1], [E6], [E22], [E26], [E34].

The market capitalization of ₹ 6,240 Cr is completely detached from reality when weighed against a staggering price-to-book ratio of 86.40x and an EV/EBITDA multiple of 32,941.5x, both of which tower far above sector benchmarks [E1, E2, E6, E10]. Operational performance underscores severe weakness, evidenced by a deeply negative operating cash flow and free cash flow of Rs -56.38 Cr in March 2026, alongside a dismal 10-year median return on equity of -1% and a multi-year trend of declining profits [E8, E15, E18, E23, E24]. Compounding this alarming risk profile, promoters have dramatically abandoned ship, slashing their stake by 74.12 percentage points from 74.37% in December 2023 down to just 0.25% by September 2026 [E26]. Furthermore, the business suffers from structural inefficiencies such as exceptionally high debtors of 255 days, a low interest coverage ratio, and a dividend yield of 0.00% [E3, E33, E36]. Price momentum has dangerously outpaced fundamentals, with share price growth over the past year exceeding profit growth by an astonishing 2,899% while delivering a stagnant ROCE of just 0.23% [E9, E17, E29]. conceded: [E13]

While the bear attacks the high valuation multiples and cash flow figures [E1, E10, E23], results score a strong 81 out of 100 on the basis of improving performance [E45]. Net profit has surged by 567% year-over-year, earnings growth is actively accelerating, and quarterly profits are moving higher [E39, E41, E42]. The company maintains a 10-year compounded sales growth of 102% alongside a trailing twelve-month sales growth of 21% and a 97% surge in trailing profit growth, proving top-line and bottom-line expansion [E13, E14, E16]. Furthermore, the company is almost debt free [E31], and trailing twelve-month profit performance outpaces the sector median profit growth of 21.6% [E47]. conceded: [E1, E10, E23, E26].

Conceded: [E39, E47]. While the bull points to a 567% year-over-year net profit surge and sector-beating growth [E39, E47], this performance is detached from underlying fundamentals, with a multi-year history of a 0% to -1% median return on equity [E19, E20] and a low 0.17% ROE over the last 3 years [E35]. The massive 2,996% compounded share price growth over one year [E17] has completely detached from operational reality, creating a staggering price-led discrepancy where price growth exceeds profit growth by 2,899% [E29]. Furthermore, promoters have fled this speculative surge, liquidating their stake from 74.37% down to a negligible 0.25% [E26], which directly undermines confidence in the company's long-term trajectory. Operating and free cash flows have plunged into a severe deficit of negative Rs 56.38 Cr in March 2026 [E23, E24], exposing the bottom-line metrics as cash-starved. Finally, paying an extreme 86.24x to 86.40x book value [E1, E6] for a business with high debtors of 255 days [E36] and negative long-term profit growth of -22% over 5 years [E15] represents an unsustainable valuation detached from evidence.
